title: wb_ppdb
description: Per-prefix/per-game profile database file (.wb.ppdb) used by wb-runtime.

schema.description: Schema version; must be exactly 1 for this revision.

prefix.description: Prefix name override; optional — wb uses its own prefix resolution if absent.

env.description: Environment variables injected at launch time.

pre_exec.description: Shell snippets executed before Wine is invoked (M5/wb-hooks.sh).

post_exec.description: Shell snippets executed after Wine exits (M5/wb-hooks.sh).
